a.lede: Apple is taking a big swing at the smart home market with its latest product that competes with Amazon Echo Show and Google Nest Hub.
a.title: Apple makes another push into the smart home market with HomeView

b.lede: The new devices work with HomeView, the company's new smart home hub which can be used to control accessories and interact with apps.
b.title: Apple’s new smart home lineup includes a smart lock, thermostat, and video doorbells
